## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A shadow record per gatekeeper run appends judged verdict, both score...

The system SHALL ensure that a shadow record per gatekeeper run appends judged verdict, both score distributions and the acting verdict to loop-state.json phase_history, asserted against a fixture run.

#### Scenario: A shadow record per gatekeeper run appends judged verdict, both score...

WHEN `run-the-gatekeeper-as-a-scored-decision-in-shadow-mode` is implemented
THEN A shadow record per gatekeeper run appends judged verdict, both score distributions and the acting verdict to loop-state.json phase_history, asserted against a fixture run.

### Requirement: The acting verdict is byte-identical to today's for every run in the shadow...

The system SHALL ensure that the acting verdict is byte-identical to today's for every run in the shadow period, proven by a replay test over recorded gate_signals.

#### Scenario: The acting verdict is byte-identical to today's for every run in the shadow...

WHEN `run-the-gatekeeper-as-a-scored-decision-in-shadow-mode` is implemented
THEN The acting verdict is byte-identical to today's for every run in the shadow period, proven by a replay test over recorded gate_signals.

### Requirement: The code-computed verdict is derived from the two Score distributions with...

The system SHALL ensure that the code-computed verdict is derived from the two Score distributions with thresholds read from config; the Choice verdict is recorded only as a cross-check.

#### Scenario: The code-computed verdict is derived from the two Score distributions with...

WHEN `run-the-gatekeeper-as-a-scored-decision-in-shadow-mode` is implemented
THEN The code-computed verdict is derived from the two Score distributions with thresholds read from config; the Choice verdict is recorded only as a cross-check.

### Requirement: A reporting script emits the GATEKEEPER disagreement rate over the shadow...

The system SHALL ensure that a reporting script emits the GATEKEEPER disagreement rate over the shadow period's runs.

#### Scenario: A reporting script emits the GATEKEEPER disagreement rate over the shadow...

WHEN `run-the-gatekeeper-as-a-scored-decision-in-shadow-mode` is implemented
THEN A reporting script emits the GATEKEEPER disagreement rate over the shadow period's runs.

### Requirement: --force and the scope-safety floor are untouched, covered by existing...

The system SHALL ensure that --force and the scope-safety floor are untouched, covered by existing autopilot tests passing unmodified.

#### Scenario: --force and the scope-safety floor are untouched, covered by existing...

WHEN `run-the-gatekeeper-as-a-scored-decision-in-shadow-mode` is implemented
THEN --force and the scope-safety floor are untouched, covered by existing autopilot tests passing unmodified.
